# Alexander Simonovsky — Product Design Portfolio

> Product designer focused on consumer and AI-powered products. Selected work, independent products, contact information and CV.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio overview](https://simonovsky.com/portfolio.md): Russian-language text version of the homepage, with selected work, independent projects and contact links.
- [CV](https://simonovsky.com/cv.md): Current English CV.

## Case studies

- [Lexie × Studypaths](https://simonovsky.com/cases/studypaths/studypaths.md): Russian-language text case about redesigning an AI learning app serving 150K+ users.
- [Dreamerz](https://simonovsky.com/cases/dreamerz/dreamerz.md): Russian-language text case about a social gaming platform, onboarding, tournaments and quests.
- [paced.ai](https://simonovsky.com/ru/cases/paced.ai/paced.ai.md): Russian-language case study of an education platform, courses, calendar, grading and design system.
- [Xi Labs](https://simonovsky.com/cases/xi-labs/xi-labs.md): Russian-language text about the project preview on the homepage.
